Project Overview

This project involved designing and developing a cutting-edge WordPress website for the New England Agency, a provider of advanced artificial intelligence integrations and software workflows. The client requested a futuristic, high-tech styling utilizing dark mode aesthetics, glowing components, and clean grid structures to demonstrate their AI consulting services, workflow templates, and client success stories.

Using WordPress and Elementor, I built a highly responsive page structure highlighting micro-interactions, clean cards layout, and structural hierarchy matching premium tech websites.

Key Challenges & Solutions

Challenge: Developing a high-tech glowing look inside Elementor without causing performance bloat or code heavy pages.

Solution: Instead of heavy JS animation libraries, I utilized custom CSS rules for gradient card frames and glowing border shadows. I also set up Elementor containers to use flexbox structures, keeping the rendered DOM extremely lightweight and ensuring fast loading times despite the rich graphics.

Core Features Implemented

  • Modern dark-mode UI with electric blue and spring green highlights.
  • Sleek, responsive service grids with hover card glowing animations.
  • AI workflow demonstration accordion columns.
  • Optimized layouts and SVGs for fast loading scores.
  • Lead generation flows and form connections.
